Committee: Education Policy
Sponsor: Allen
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 02/01/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 127 as introduced proposes a constitutional amendment which, if ratified, could increase the administrative costs of local boards of education by an undetermined amount to establish policies requiring each public K-12 school to broadcast "The Star-Spangled Banner" at school-sanctioned sporting events and at least once a week during school hours.
In addition, this bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2023.
Tim Melson, Chairperson
Education Policy

Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Livingston
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 02/28/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 196 as passed the Senate proposes a Constitutional Amendment, that if ratified, could increase the administrative obligations of the Governor's office to require the Governor to notify the Attorney General, and a designated member of a victims family, prior to granting a commutation or reprieve to persons sentenced to death.
This amendment could increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2023.
Jim Hill, Chair
Judiciary
